tools.name: companies_create-company
tools.description: Creates a new company. You can optionally include contacts in the request body to create the company with contacts in a single request. If no contacts are provided, the company will be placed in an 'inactive' status until the [company has primary contacts added](#tag/Contacts). Once contacts are added, the company will move to 'Active'. Required: address, billOnBehalfOfEnabled, name, orderApprovalRequired, phone, selfServiceAllowed, website. Optional: contacts, externalId, id (plus 2 more). Returns array of Contact.

params.description: The city

params.name: address-country
params.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code for the country

params.name: address-postal-code
params.description: The postal code

params.name: address-state-or-province
params.description: The state or province

params.name: address-street
params.description: The primary street information

params.name: address-street2
params.description: The secondary street information

params.name: billOnBehalfOfEnabled
params.description: Value is ```true``` if Pax8 handles billing transactions, value is ```false``` if partner handles billing transactions

params.name: contacts
params.description: Optional array of contacts to create with the company. Including contacts during company creation will set the company status to 'Active' immediately.

params.name: externalId
params.description: An external ID that can be assigned to the company for reference

params.name: id
params.description: The unique id of the company

params.name: name
params.description: The company name

params.name: orderApprovalRequired
params.description: Value is ```true``` if the company's self-service orders require approval, otherwise value is ```false```

params.name: phone
params.description: The primary phone number of the company

params.name: selfServiceAllowed
params.description: Value is ```true``` if self-service privileges are available to the company, otherwise value is ```false```

params.name: status
params.description: Company Status: * `Active` - The company is active * `Inactive` - The company is inactive due to missing contacts * `Deleted` - The company has been deleted

params.name: updatedDate
params.description: The date and time the company was last updated

params.name: website
params.description: The full URL of the company website

tools.name: invoices_find-partner-draft-items
tools.description: Fetch a paginated list of draft invoice items before they are finalized into invoices. Default page is 0 and default size is 10. The maximum page size is 200. DISCLAIMER: For future-dated items, the data represents a snapshot of charges that will be applied to a future invoice as of the request date. This is not an actual invoice. Clients should be aware that the final invoice generated on the 5th of the month may differ. This endpoint does not include charges for usage-based products billed in arrears. Tax calculations are based on current account taxability status and current month tax rates, both of which are subject to change for future invoices. Optional: page (default: 0), size (default: 10), monthOffset (default: 1) (plus 1 more). Returns array of InvoiceItem.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to request in the draft invoice items list

params.name: size
params.description: Returns _this_ number of draft invoice items per page

params.name: monthOffset
params.description: Number of months from current to return draft items for. 0 = current month, 1 = next month. Only values 0 and 1 are currently supported. If omitted, defaults to 1 (next month).

params.name: companyId
params.description: Filter draft items to a specific company.
